heading: Eviction of tenant before Rent Controller
title: Eviction of tenant before Rent Controller
text: (1) A landlord seeking to evict his tenant shall apply to the Controller for an order in that behalf only on the grounds of: (a) default in payment of rent within sixty days; (b) subletting without written consent; (c) personal bona fide need of the landlord or his children.
